threat_event: Attacker uses a stolen managed services engineer session to push a malicious script through the RMM tool to managed customer servers, including bank customers, and tries to pivot into the HCP
threat_source: Cybercriminal or ransomware affiliate targeting MSPs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 shared RMM super-administrator accounts used by the on-call rotation; scripts run across all 410 customers with no second approval; RMM logs not in the SIEM; vendor keeps logs 90 days
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08; SYS-03; about 11,200 customer servers; BP-07; BP-06
sp800_53_controls: AC-2; AC-6; AC-17; AU-2; SI-4; SR-6
existing_controls: Hardware keys on the RMM console; EDR on managed servers; MDR partner
treatment_plan: Retire the 2 shared accounts; two-person approval for any script that targets more than one customer; RMM logs to the SIEM; per-customer engineer scoping; RMM compromise runbook (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$10M (customer recovery support, credits, notices, counsel; bank customers affected)

threat_event: Theft of commercial control plane service credentials lets an attacker delete, snapshot, or copy any commercial customer VM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial deployment holds long-lived credentials that act on all 13 commercial clusters; the government deployment uses scoped short-lived credentials
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C IA-5, AC-6); MSA confidentiality clause
existing_controls: Credentials in the secrets vault; pipeline-only deployment; bulk-action alerts in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Issue scoped short-lived credentials per job and per cluster, as in the government deployment; alert on bulk snapshot or delete actions

threat_event: Attacker who reaches the DC-1 management network takes over hypervisor managers or host BMCs of clusters A and B
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 clusters A and B use local accounts with passwords and no MFA, are reached through a legacy VPN and jump host outside PAM, and accept connections from the NOC network
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 (DC-1); SYS-05 (DC-1 clusters A and B, 64 hosts); BP-01
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C IA-2, AC-4, SC-7)
existing_controls: Jump host with MFA; EDR on the jump host; firewall logging
treatment_plan: Federate the 2 clusters through PAM; deny-by-default from the NOC network; retire the legacy VPN path

threat_event: Destructive or ransomware attack deletes or encrypts the control plane and tries to delete its backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups are immutable and isolated, but the commercial partition has never been restored within its RTO
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C CP-9, CP-6, CP-10); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4(a))
existing_controls: Write-once backups in a separate account and second region; two-person deletion; EDR
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests for both partitions; ransomware tabletop with the OFAC sanctions check step (P08)

threat_event: The commercial control plane cannot be restored within its 4-hour RTO after a failure or attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The only commercial restore test (2025) took 9 hours; the commercial runbook is not rehearsed
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C CP-4, CP-10); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4(a))
existing_controls: Point-in-time recovery; government runbook rehearsed quarterly
treatment_plan: Adopt the government runbook for the commercial partition; quarterly restore tests until two pass within 4 hours

threat_event: Exploitation of an unpatched hypervisor, storage controller, or BMC vulnerability, including KEV-listed flaws
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial clusters scanned quarterly; 14% of DC-1 BMCs on outdated firmware; KEV matching manual; 9 DC-1 storage controllers past end of support
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C RA-5, SI-2; VDR and VER rules)
existing_controls: Monthly authenticated scans of government clusters; management network isolation at DC-2 and DC-3
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans for all clusters; automated KEV matching; quarterly BMC firmware cycle; replace end-of-support controllers

threat_event: Credential stuffing or phishing takes over a commercial customer administrator account, and the attacker deletes or copies that customer's VMs and changes DNS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial customer administrator MFA optional (58% enrolled); no address proofing beyond email
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C IA-8; SCG rules); MSA
existing_controls: Lockout and progressive delays; breached-password checks; sign-in alerts
treatment_plan: Require MFA for commercial customer administrators; risk-based sign-in alerts to customers

threat_event: Hypervisor flaw lets a VM reach another tenant's memory or storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared hypervisors for commercial tenants; patch delays on DC-1 clusters A and B
existing_controls: Government clusters are physically separate; vendor advisories monitored
treatment_plan: Patch hypervisor flaws within the VDR timeframes for all clusters

threat_event: A privileged engineer views or copies customer VM data without a business need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 214 engineers hold privileged roles; commercial roles are standing with semiannual reviews
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C AC-6, AC-2, AU-6); MSA confidentiality clause
existing_controls: Background checks; PAM recording at DC-2 and DC-3; confidentiality agreements
treatment_plan: Just-in-time elevation for all clusters and commercial accounts; quarterly reviews; privileged activity review

threat_event: A former employee or transferred engineer uses access that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 local accounts outside the HR-driven workflow; 2 of 25 sampled terminations removed late
existing_controls: Same-day identity provider disablement; transfer reviews
treatment_plan: Add DC-1 local accounts to the termination checklist until federation

threat_event: Malicious code is inserted into the CI/CD pipeline or a commercial VM template that customers deploy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial signing key is a pipeline secret; signatures not verified at deployment in the commercial partition; no SBOM or build provenance
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C SI-7, SC-12, CM-5)
existing_controls: Two approvers; signed commits; HSM signing for government templates
treatment_plan: Move the commercial key into the HSM; verify signatures at deployment in both partitions; SBOM and signed provenance per release

threat_event: Volumetric DDoS against authoritative DNS and the edge network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DNS and edge serve every customer; the 2-hour MTD is the shortest in the BIA
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C SC-5); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4(a)); MSA
existing_controls: Contracted scrubbing service; secondary DNS; two carriers per site
treatment_plan: Annual scrubbing failover test; DNS anycast at a third site

threat_event: Hijack of the company's own domains through registrar account compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Registrar account protected by MFA but not registry lock for the portal domain
existing_controls: Registrar MFA; DNSSEC
treatment_plan: Registry lock on the portal and API domains

threat_event: Phishing takes over a workforce SSO account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hardware security keys for all workforce limit phishing to session theft
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant keys; quarterly phishing tests; EDR
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: keys and EDR keep the likelihood of adverse impact very low

threat_event: An intrusion goes undetected or cannot be investigated because key logs are not collected or kept
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 clusters A and B and the RMM tool not in the SIEM; BMC remote logging disabled on 2 clusters; commercial logs 90 days online
existing_controls: Complete government logging; MDR partner 24x7; source-silence alerts
treatment_plan: Onboard DC-1 clusters A and B and the RMM tool; enable BMC remote logging; 1-year online retention for both partitions

threat_event: AI triage closes or down-ranks a true-positive alert, such as early signs of a tooling compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-close enabled for commercial alerts; 68% closed without review in July 2026; no sampling of closed alerts (P10 AI-001)
existing_controls: Auto-close disabled for government alerts; MDR partner sees EDR alerts directly
treatment_plan: Disable auto-close for privileged-access, RMM, and pipeline alerts; weekly sample of 50 auto-closed alerts; P10 conditions

threat_event: An untested change to data center networks or hypervisors causes a wide outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Change advisory board in place; DC-1 drift checked monthly; 11% of DC-1 hosts had unapproved deviations
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C CM-3, CM-6; SCN rules); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4(a))
existing_controls: Change advisory board; staged rollouts
treatment_plan: Weekly drift scans for all clusters; clear the DC-1 deviations

threat_event: Hurricane or facility failure takes DC-1 offline for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 holds about 54% of commercial VMs; only replicated VMs (about 35%) can fail over; no commercial contingency plan or failover test
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C CP-2, CP-7); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4(a)); MSA SLA
existing_controls: Colocation built to withstand high winds with generators; paid replication tier; government VMs not at DC-1
treatment_plan: One contingency plan for both partitions with a DC-1 site-loss runbook (P08); first DC-1 failover exercise; replication or backup by default for DC-1 bank customers; capacity at DC-2 and DC-3
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.0M immediate plus about $1.24M a year of churn (BIA scenario)

threat_event: Power or cooling failure at a colocation facility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inherited from colocation providers; DC-1 suppression subcontractor carved out of the provider's report
existing_controls: N+1 power and cooling; provider SOC 2 reports reviewed
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; reviewed with each SOC 2 report

threat_event: A storage array firmware defect corrupts customer volumes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware upgrades staged by cluster; backups only for customers who buy them
existing_controls: Staged firmware rollouts; vendor support
treatment_plan: Hold firmware for 30 days after release unless a security fix; snapshot before upgrades

threat_event: Upstream carrier outage at one data center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two carriers per site on diverse paths
existing_controls: Two carriers; priority-of-service terms
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Bank customers are not notified within the bank service provider rule after a material disruption of 4 hours or more
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Designated contacts verified for 31 of 38 banks (last 2025-11); the 4-hour determination step has never been exercised
existing_controls: Bank addendum; notice step in the 2024 plan
treatment_plan: Verify all 38 contacts quarterly; exercise the 4-hour determination in both P08 tabletops

threat_event: FedRAMP requests corrective action or the Government Cloud loses its certification because the 2026 rules transition misses ruleset deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No transition plan; no machine-readable package, trust center, Ongoing Certification Reports, or PAIN-based vulnerability and incident processes (P03)
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026: VDR and VER from 2026-12-07; most rulesets from 2027-01-01; all grace periods end 2028-02-01)
existing_controls: Current Rev5 Moderate certification; monthly deliverables; FedRAMP Security Inbox
treatment_plan: Run the P03 transition roadmap with quarterly status to the audit committee; machine-readable package and trust center by 2027-04-02
exposure_estimate_usd: $14M a year of Government Cloud revenue; 19 defense customers depend on Moderate status

threat_event: Customer data is recovered from a failed drive that leaves a data center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 destruction certificates are batched; 3 of 20 sampled serial numbers could not be matched
existing_controls: Cryptographic erase before destruction; certified vendor
treatment_plan: Serial-level certificates at every site

threat_event: A breach at the RMM, SIEM, code hosting, or another Tier 1 vendor exposes the company's customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual reviews done for 9 of 14 Tier 1 vendors; RMM SOC 2 exceptions never followed up; 4 Tier 1 contracts lack incident notice terms
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C SR-6, SA-9; MAS-CSO-TPR); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4)
existing_controls: Vendor tiering; FedRAMP-certified vendors for government services
treatment_plan: Complete Tier 1 reviews; follow up RMM exceptions; add incident notice terms by amendment (P09 vendor reviews)

threat_event: A long-lived, unowned machine credential (like the 2024 deploy token found in P07) is used to change the government partition outside the pipeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Machine tokens were not in the secrets inventory and had no expiry; the found token was revoked 2026-08-15, but others may exist
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C IA-5, CM-5, AC-2; IEC rules if exploited)
existing_controls: Token revoked; pipeline-only deployment; secret scanning
treatment_plan: Inventory every machine credential; 90-day maximum lifetime; quarterly review of every identity that can change production

threat_event: A customer VM is used for phishing or botnet activity and company IP ranges are blocklisted
threat_source: Customer or attacker using a customer VM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Abuse handling relies on complaints
existing_controls: Abuse desk; acceptable use terms
treatment_plan: Outbound traffic anomaly alerts for commercial tenant networks
owner: Director of NOC and Customer Support

threat_event: Support staff share one customer's snapshot, ticket, or data with the wrong tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual snapshot sharing in support workflows; support reply assistant drafts answers (AI-003)
existing_controls: Role-based support tooling; tenant checks in the portal
treatment_plan: Tenant check before any snapshot share; human review of every AI draft (P10)
owner: Director of NOC and Customer Support

threat_event: The company misses customer notice duties after a breach of customer data (MSA 72 hours; state third-party agent duties)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notices handled case by case; no matrix by customer type before P08
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) (each state where affected individuals reside); MSA 72-hour notice
existing_controls: General Counsel review of each notice
treatment_plan: P08 notification matrix and templates; include in tabletops

threat_event: A FedRAMP Reportable Incident is not reported within the Class C timeframes (1 hour for PAIN-3 to PAIN-5)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 plan has no reportability evaluation or PAIN rating; no trust center; reports sent by hand
existing_controls: Federal incident response coordinator role; FedRAMP Security Inbox
treatment_plan: Reportability and PAIN steps in P08; report templates in the FedRAMP JSON format; on-call coordinator; tabletop
exposure_estimate_usd: Certification and agency trust; hard to quantify

threat_event: Validated cryptography cannot be shown for every service that protects federal customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Government modules are FIPS 140 validated but not documented per service in the 2026 format; commercial modules undocumented
existing_controls: FIPS 140-validated modules in the government partition
treatment_plan: Document modules per service for the package

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes cached data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption and EDR on all endpoints
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: CUI or federal data is placed in the commercial partition or a managed services server (spillage)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSA prohibits it, but there is no technical check; spillage procedure never exercised
existing_controls: Contract terms; spillage procedure
treatment_plan: Add the DFARS path to the spillage procedure; exercise it; sales screening for federal workloads

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting a defense customer's covered defense information is not reported to DoD within 72 hours, or images are not preserved for 90 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The flow-down duties are in contracts but not in the 2024 plan; no DoD-approved medium assurance certificate held by the company
existing_controls: Government logs kept 1 year online
treatment_plan: Add the DFARS path to P08; obtain a medium assurance certificate; image preservation procedure

threat_event: The next annual assessment finds the boundary too narrow because the pipeline, identity, SIEM, and ITSM tenants were treated as external
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 boundary; CMDB lacks partition and third-party resource tags
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (MAS-CSO-IIR, MAS-CSO-TPR; Rev5 Class C CM-8)
existing_controls: P02 boundary expanded in this cycle
treatment_plan: Tag every component by partition and data role; document third-party information resources

threat_event: An emergency FedRAMP message is acted on late (as in the April 2026 Emergency Test)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The FedRAMP Security Inbox reaches only the Director of Security; no on-call routing
existing_controls: Inbox established 2026-01-05
treatment_plan: Route the inbox to the SOC on-call queue with a 1-hour acknowledgment target; quarterly test

threat_event: A compromised third-party component in a VM template or control plane release reaches customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SBOM or provenance; dependency scanning only
existing_controls: Dependency scanning; static analysis
treatment_plan: SBOM for every template and release; check against advisories

threat_event: Data on about 9,000 older unencrypted commercial volumes is exposed through a storage or drive handling error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Volume encryption default only since 2025-01
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (Rev5 Class C SC-28); MSA confidentiality clause
existing_controls: Cryptographic erase of drives; locked cages
treatment_plan: Encrypt the remaining volumes during maintenance windows

threat_event: The 4-person GRC team cannot run the FedRAMP transition, the expanded SOC 2, and vendor reviews at once, so deadlines slip
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same team writes the package, runs continuous monitoring, SOC 2, and vendor reviews
existing_controls: Co-sourced internal audit; FedRAMP independent assessor
treatment_plan: Two GRC hires in FY2027; FedRAMP advisor for the package conversion

threat_event: The coding assistant suggests insecure code or receives secrets or customer data in prompts (AI-002)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Used by about 70 engineers with no review; enterprise terms not checked for data retention
existing_controls: Two approvers per pull request; static analysis
treatment_plan: Enterprise tier with no training on company data; block use on government repositories until reviewed; secret scanning on prompts (P10)

threat_event: The support reply assistant drafts an answer with another customer's details or wrong recovery steps (AI-003)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drafts are sent after agent edit, but there is no required review step
existing_controls: Agents edit drafts
treatment_plan: Required human review; retrieval limited to the requesting customer's tickets (P10)
owner: Director of NOC and Customer Support

threat_event: AI resume screening disadvantages applicants in a protected group (AI-005)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without a bias review or vendor validation evidence
regulatory_driver: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); state laws where applicants reside
existing_controls: Recruiters review shortlisted resumes
treatment_plan: Automated ranking paused 2026-09-22; restart only after a bias review and vendor validation, with human review of every applicant (P10)

threat_event: The hardware failure and capacity forecasting model under-predicts demand or failures (AI-004)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model in use without validation records
existing_controls: Engineers review forecasts monthly
treatment_plan: Back-test quarterly against actual failures and capacity (P10)

threat_event: The status page or NOC channels fail during a major incident, so customers and banks receive no updates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Status page on a separate provider; NOC phones depend on corporate telephony
existing_controls: Separately hosted status page; secondary NOC desk
treatment_plan: Out-of-band call tree and bank contact list on NOC phones
owner: Director of NOC and Customer Support

threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered hardware enters a cluster
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Authorized distributors only; no inspection on receipt
existing_controls: Authorized distributors; firmware baselines
treatment_plan: Receiving inspection checklist, starting with government cluster purchases

threat_event: A new vendor or contractor arrangement gives a covered person access to government-related data without review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No 28 CFR Part 202 check in vendor onboarding before 2026
existing_controls: All staff and contractors U.S.-based; government cluster access limited to U.S. persons
treatment_plan: Add a Part 202 question to vendor and contractor onboarding

threat_event: A caller tricks the NOC into resetting a customer administrator's MFA or password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recovery verification relies on knowledge questions for commercial customers
existing_controls: Callback to the registered number for government customers
treatment_plan: Callback and second-administrator approval for all MFA resets
owner: Director of NOC and Customer Support

threat_event: The DC-1 storage vendor's standing remote support access is misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor remote tool with standing access outside PAM at DC-1
existing_controls: Vendor contract; storage array audit logs
treatment_plan: Move vendor support to PAM with approval and recording

threat_event: An expired certificate or a DNSSEC key rollover error breaks the portal or customer DNS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Expiry alerts exist; key rollovers are manual
existing_controls: Certificate inventory with expiry alerts
treatment_plan: Automate certificate renewal and DNSSEC rollovers

threat_event: The expanded SOC 2 examination (Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, managed services, DC-3) ends with a qualified opinion or many exceptions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New scope areas have no prior testing; RMM and backup controls have open gaps (P09)
existing_controls: Current SOC 2 Type 2 with 3 exceptions
treatment_plan: Readiness remediation before 2027-01-01 (P09)

threat_event: A cyber insurance claim is reduced because incident vendors were engaged before notice through the carrier hotline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Policy condition not in the 2024 plan
existing_controls: General Counsel knows the condition
treatment_plan: Carrier hotline step in both P08 runbooks
exposure_estimate_usd: Up to the $15M limit at stake

threat_event: A ransom payment is considered without a sanctions check
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written payment decision procedure
existing_controls: General Counsel and outside counsel
treatment_plan: Payment decision step with OFAC screening and CEO approval in P08
